none: PAS CAM-383476: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of Constantine I, AD306-337
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ SOLI INVICTO COMITI ; D/ CONSTANTINVS P AVG

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine I, AD306-337 (Reece period 15). Reverse legend reads SOLI INVICTO COMITI. Reverse shows Sol standing left. Mint is London, AD316-317. See RIC vol.VII, p.102, no.93. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS P AVG. Obverse shows Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue read: T/F//PLN. Condition is very fine. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight is 3.47g,…
